$description: Glass-bars contract (wave-XVI W2; refs AI2_ref/NEU/Alice/* + main2.png — pearl glass bars, gold edges): translucent layers rail/topbar/card/statusbar. Per layer: bg alpha 0.35–0.65 over shell art, backdrop blur 14–28px @ saturate 1.2, 1px inner border (alpha 0.12–0.25), top highlight over 0–8% height, directional shadow. glass.minOpacity = contrast floor — if text on the composited layer drops <4.5:1 on the theme's own substrates, the layer alpha must be raised to at least this value (asserted in glass-bars.test.ts). glass.maxBlurLayers = 4 — budget of simultaneous backdrop-filter layers per screen. Persona tone binds in component css via [data-persona] → --nexus-glass-tone (personaEdge.*), no per-persona token duplicates. bgOpaque = same-tone opaque composite for @supports/reduced-transparency/forced-colors fallbacks.

saturate.$description: backdrop-filter saturate() factor shared by all glass layers.

minOpacity.$description: Minimum layer bg alpha allowed when contrast correction is applied; all layers already sit at/above it.

maxBlurLayers.$description: Performance budget: max simultaneous backdrop-filter surfaces per screen (rail + topbar + statusbar + card zone = 4).

highlightSize.$description: Height of the top-edge light catch (gradient fades within 0–8% of the layer).

bg.$description: Left rail glass over art — alpha .55 (in 0.35–0.65 band).

shadow.$description: Rightward cast — rail floats over the canvas.
Downward cast — header floats over content.
Upward cast — bottom status bar floats over content.
